# Metrics reference

For: admins. You scrape the server's metrics with Prometheus.

<!-- Generated by `make generate-docs` from the metrics' Help text. Do not edit this file; change the Help text in the code instead. -->

This page lists every metric of the server. [configuration.md](../configuration.md#endpoints) explains the two metrics ports and what to scrape.

## Per-replica metrics

Each replica serves these on its metrics port (`VAULT_SYNC_METRICS_LISTEN_ADDRESS`, `/metrics`), besides the standard Go runtime (`go_*`) and process (`process_*`) metrics.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vault_sync_rpc_requests_total` | counter | `procedure`, `code` | RPCs handled, by full procedure name (for example /vaultsync.v1.ServerInfoService/GetServerInfo) and Connect status code (ok, unimplemented, ...). Calls rejected for authentication are counted with code unauthenticated. Requests rejected before reaching an RPC handler (oversized declared bodies, unknown routes, malformed messages) are not counted. |
| `vault_sync_rpc_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `procedure`, `code` | Time spent handling each RPC, by procedure and Connect status code. |
| `vault_sync_rpc_concurrency_rejections_total` | counter | `procedure` | Authenticated RPCs rejected with resource_exhausted because their user already had VAULT_SYNC_MAX_CONCURRENT_RPCS_PER_USER calls in flight on this replica, by procedure. These calls are also counted in vault_sync_rpc_requests_total with code resource_exhausted. |
| `vault_sync_rpc_in_flight` | gauge |  | Authenticated RPCs in flight on this replica, counted until their response is written. |
| `vault_sync_rpc_in_flight_users` | gauge |  | Users with at least one authenticated RPC in flight on this replica. |
| `vault_sync_retention_revisions_purged_total` | counter |  | Revisions this replica's retention job purged. |
| `vault_sync_retention_blobs_collected_total` | counter |  | Blobs no revision references whose rows this replica's retention job deleted. |
| `vault_sync_retention_objects_deleted_total` | counter |  | Collected blobs' S3 objects this replica's retention job deleted. |
| `vault_sync_retention_purge_markers_pruned_total` | counter |  | Purge markers older than VAULT_SYNC_RETENTION_PURGE_MARKER_HORIZON that this replica's retention job deleted. A run prunes at most 100,000: growth by that much every run means pruning is falling behind the purges. |
| `vault_sync_retention_vaults_purged_total` | counter |  | Vaults deleted more than 30 days ago whose rows and S3 objects this replica's retention job purged. |
| `vault_sync_retention_run_failures_total` | counter |  | Retention runs on this replica that failed in part (logged as retention run failed); the next run retries. Alert if it keeps rising. |
| `vault_sync_db_pool_acquired_connections` | gauge |  | PostgreSQL connections of this replica's pool in use. |
| `vault_sync_db_pool_idle_connections` | gauge |  | Open PostgreSQL connections idle in this replica's pool. |
| `vault_sync_db_pool_waiting_acquires` | gauge |  | Requests for a PostgreSQL connection from this replica's pool in progress. Sustained values near the pool size mean the pool is too small or the database is slow. |
| `vault_sync_db_pool_acquire_duration_seconds` | histogram |  | Time to get a PostgreSQL connection from this replica's pool, including waiting for one and opening it. |
| `vault_sync_db_query_errors_total` | counter |  | PostgreSQL queries and statements that failed, including those the server expects and handles (such as a commit losing a race) and those canceled with their request. Alert on a sustained rise. |
| `vault_sync_s3_requests_total` | counter | `operation`, `outcome` | S3 operations, by S3 API operation (PutObject, GetObject, HeadBucket, ...) and outcome: ok, not_found (HTTP 404, expected for example when deleting a missing object) or error. One operation counts once, however often the SDK retried it. |
| `vault_sync_s3_request_duration_seconds` | histogram | `operation`, `outcome` | Time each S3 operation took, retries included, by operation and outcome. |
| `vault_sync_blob_uploaded_bytes_total` | counter |  | Blob chunk bytes clients uploaded that this replica accepted. |
| `vault_sync_blob_downloaded_bytes_total` | counter |  | Blob bytes this replica served to clients' downloads. |
| `vault_sync_oidc_jwks_refresh_failures_total` | counter |  | Fetches of the OIDC issuer's discovery document and key set that failed; the server keeps using the keys it has. |
| `vault_sync_oidc_jwks_age_seconds` | gauge |  | Seconds since this replica last fetched the OIDC issuer's key set successfully; NaN before the first fetch. Keys are fetched when a token needs them and at most hourly, so on an idle replica the age keeps growing; alert on a high age together with refresh failures. |
| `vault_sync_realtime_connections` | gauge |  | Open realtime WebSocket connections on this replica. |
| `vault_sync_realtime_refused_upgrades_total` | counter | `reason` | Realtime WebSocket upgrades refused, by reason: origin, unauthenticated, protocol, user_limit, instance_limit, draining, unavailable. |
| `vault_sync_realtime_disconnects_total` | counter | `reason` | Realtime WebSocket connections ended, by reason: client, drain, slow_client, rate_limit, invalid_frame, frame_too_large, token_expired, ping_timeout, write_failed. |
| `vault_sync_realtime_notifications_total` | counter |  | vault_changed frames queued to realtime clients. |
| `vault_sync_realtime_listener_up` | gauge |  | 1 while this replica listens for commits (PostgreSQL LISTEN), 0 while it reconnects. Alert if it stays 0. |
| `vault_sync_realtime_listener_reconnects_total` | counter |  | Times the commit listener lost its database connection and reconnected. |

## Service-wide metrics

These describe the whole deployment. Every replica serves the same values, only on its service-wide metrics port (`VAULT_SYNC_SERVICE_METRICS_LISTEN_ADDRESS`, `/metrics`). [configuration.md](../configuration.md#service-wide-metrics) explains how they are refreshed.

| Metric | Type | Labels | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `vault_sync_service_devices` | gauge |  | Devices registered and not removed. |
| `vault_sync_service_users_with_devices` | gauge |  | Users with at least one device not removed. |
| `vault_sync_service_active_devices_24h` | gauge |  | Devices not removed that committed within the last 24 hours (a device's last activity is recorded at most once a minute). |
| `vault_sync_service_active_devices_30d` | gauge |  | Devices not removed that committed within the last 30 days. |
| `vault_sync_service_vaults` | gauge | `encryption`, `shared` | Vaults not deleted, by encryption (none, e2ee) and shared (true when the vault has more than one member, false otherwise). Every combination is always exported. |
| `vault_sync_service_vault_memberships` | gauge |  | Memberships of vaults not deleted. |
| `vault_sync_service_pending_invitations` | gauge |  | Unexpired invitations to vaults not deleted. |
| `vault_sync_service_live_documents_approximate` | gauge |  | Approximate documents not deleted, read from PostgreSQL planner statistics (pg_class.reltuples) instead of counting rows, which autovacuum and ANALYZE update; 0 until the table is first analyzed. Deleted vaults' documents count until the vault is purged. |
| `vault_sync_service_revisions_approximate` | gauge |  | Approximate stored revisions, from PostgreSQL planner statistics (pg_class.reltuples), which autovacuum and ANALYZE update; 0 until the table is first analyzed. |
| `vault_sync_service_schema_version` | gauge |  | Highest database migration version applied. During a rolling upgrade it shows when the schema is ahead of the replicas. |
| `vault_sync_service_blobs` | gauge |  | Stored blobs, from the blob rows (not an S3 listing), deleted vaults' included until purged. Exact while the planner estimates fewer than 100,000; beyond that it is that estimate (pg_class.reltuples), since every revision with content has a blob and an exact count would scan the table. |
| `vault_sync_service_blob_bytes` | gauge |  | Recorded size in bytes of the stored blobs. Exact below 100,000 blobs; beyond that approximate: the estimated blob count times the mean size in a sample of 1% of the table's pages (TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM). |
| `vault_sync_service_upload_sessions` | gauge |  | Open blob upload sessions (not yet committed, discarded or expired). |
| `vault_sync_service_upload_session_reserved_bytes` | gauge |  | Declared size in bytes of the open blob upload sessions. |
| `vault_sync_service_upload_session_oldest_age_seconds` | gauge |  | Age in seconds of the oldest open blob upload session at the last refresh; 0 without one. |
| `vault_sync_service_gc_pending_blobs` | gauge |  | Blobs released by a retention purge that the garbage collector has not deleted yet (still inside the grace period, or not yet collected). |
| `vault_sync_service_gc_pending_blob_bytes` | gauge |  | Recorded size in bytes of the blobs awaiting garbage collection. |
| `vault_sync_service_deleted_vaults` | gauge |  | Deleted vaults the vault purge has not removed yet (restorable, or waiting for the purge). |
| `vault_sync_service_rekey_vaults` | gauge |  | Encrypted vaults not deleted with at least one revision not on the vault's current epoch: a re-key in progress. |
| `vault_sync_service_stale_epoch_revisions` | gauge |  | Revisions of encrypted vaults not deleted that are not on their vault's current epoch: the re-encryption backlog (ListStaleRevisions), summed over every vault. |
| `vault_sync_service_encrypted_vaults_by_escrow` | gauge | `escrow` | Encrypted vaults not deleted, by escrow (true when escrow is on). Both values are always exported. |
| `vault_sync_service_escrow_rewrap_slots` | gauge |  | Escrow key slots of vaults not deleted that still name a retiring escrow key id (VAULT_SYNC_ESCROW_RETIRING_KEY_IDS): the re-wrap backlog of an escrow key rotation. 0 without retiring ids. |
| `vault_sync_service_retention_last_success_timestamp_seconds` | gauge |  | Unix time at which a retention run last finished without errors, on any replica; 0 before the first. Each replica runs the job every hour, so alert when it falls well behind. |
| `vault_sync_service_export_last_success_timestamp_seconds` | gauge |  | Unix time at which an export (vault-sync-server export) last finished with status ok; 0 before the first. A partial or failed export does not advance it. |
| `vault_sync_service_metrics_last_refresh_success_timestamp_seconds` | gauge |  | Unix time of the last refresh on this replica in which every service-wide query succeeded; 0 before the first. A failed query keeps its metrics' previous values. |
